abstract: BACKGROUND: The open approach represents the gold standard for postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (O-PCLND) in patients with residual testicular cancer. We analyzed laparoscopic postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (L-PCLND) and O-PCLND at our institution. METHODS: Patients underwent either L-PCLND (n = 43) or O-PCLND (n = 24). Categorical and continuous variables were compared using the Fisher exact test and Mann-Whitney U test respectively. Overall survival was evaluated with the log-rank test. RESULTS: Primary histology was embryonal cell carcinomas (18 patients), pure seminoma (2 cases) and mixed NSGCTs (47 patients). According to the IGCCCG patients were categorized into "good", "intermediate" and "poor prognosis" disease in 55.2%, 14.9% and 20.8%, respectively. Median operative time for L-PCLND was 212 min and 232 min for O-PCLND (p = 0.256). Median postoperative duration of drainage and hospital stay was shorter after L-PCLND (0.0 vs. 3.5 days; p < 0.001 and 6.0 vs. 11.5 days; p = 0.002). Intraoperative complications occurred in 21.7% (L-PCLND) and 38.0% (O-PCLND) of cases with 19.5% and 28.5% of Clavien Grade III complications for L-PCLND and O-PCLND, respectively (p = 0.224). Significant blood loss (>500 ml) was almost equally distributed (8.6% vs. 14.2%: p = 0.076). No significant differences were observed for injuries of major vessels and postoperative complications (p = 0.758; p = 0.370). Tumor recurrence occurred in 8.6% following L-PCLND and in 14.2% following O-PCLND with a mean disease-free survival of 76.6 and 89.2 months, respectively. Overall survival was 83.3 and 95.0 months for L-PCNLD and O-PCLND, respectively (p = 0.447). CONCLUSIONS: L-PCLND represents a safe surgical option for well selected patients at an experienced center.
abstract_ja: 背景：開腹手術は、残存精巣がんに対する化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清(O-PCLND)のゴールドスタンダードである。当施設における腹腔鏡下化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清(L-PCLND)とO-PCLNDを解析した。方法：患者はL-PCLND(43例)またはO-PCLND(24例)を受けた。カテゴリー変数はFisher exact検定、連続変数はMann-Whitney U検定で比較した。全生存期間(全生存率)はlog-rank検定で評価した。結果：原発組織型は胎児性癌18例、純粋セミノーマ2例、混合型非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(NSGCT)47例であった。IGCCCG分類では、「良好群」55.2%、「中間群」14.9%、「不良群」20.8%であった。L-PCLNDの手術時間中央値は212分、O-PCLNDは232分であった(p = 0.256)。術後のドレーン留置期間と在院日数の中央値はL-PCLNDの方が短かった(0.0日 対 3.5日；p < 0.001、6.0日 対 11.5日；p = 0.002)。術中合併症はL-PCLNDで21.7%、O-PCLNDで38.0%に認められ、Clavien分類グレードIIIの合併症はそれぞれ19.5%と28.5%であった(p = 0.224)。大量出血(>500ml)はほぼ同等の頻度であった(8.6% 対 14.2%：p = 0.076)。主要血管損傷および術後合併症に有意差は認めなかった(p = 0.758；p = 0.370)。再発はL-PCLNDで8.6%、O-PCLNDで14.2%に生じ、平均無病生存期間はそれぞれ76.6か月と89.2か月であった。全生存期間(全生存率)はL-PCLNDで83.3か月、O-PCLNDで95.0か月であった(p = 0.447)。結論：L-PCLNDは、経験豊富な施設において適切に選択された患者に対する安全な外科的選択肢である。
